project_info.instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: All UI text, placeholder text, and error messages MUST be in Uzbek. Follow the color palette strictly. Implement BENTO grids for marketing sections. The UI should resemble Apple's 'Liquid Glass' design trend (Glassmorphism 2.0). All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-none text-[#0A2540]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Use 2-3x more spacing than standard designs.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: p-8 or p-12 for bordered containers to prevent text collision

grid_systems.marketing_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Asymmetrical layout. Mix tall (row-span-2) and wide (col-span-2+) cards.
grid_systems.dashboard_control_room: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Dense, utilized space.
grid_systems.product_gallery: Anti-grid organic layout for hero media, strict grid for specifications.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content. Center hero headings only if visually balanced.

surfaces_and_materials.header_nav: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70 backdrop-saturate-150 border-b border-black/5. Z-index 50, sticky.
surfaces_and_materials.product_card_default: bg-[#F5F7FA] rounded-3xl border border-black/5 transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-[#3B82F6] hover:bg-[#2563EB] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all shadow-[0_4px_14px_rgba(59,130,246,0.39)] hover:shadow-[0_6px_20px_rgba(59,130,246,0.23)]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#0A2540] hover:bg-black text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all
buttons.outline: border border-[#0A2540]/20 hover:border-[#0A2540] text-[#0A2540] rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all

components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn UI overrides: rounded-xl border-black/10 bg-white/50 focus:border-[#3B82F6] focus:ring-[#3B82F6]/20
components_strategy.badges: bg-[#F5F7FA] text-[#0A2540] rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium border border-black/5
components_strategy.interactions: Hover states must have higher contrast. Focus states must ring clearly. Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').

motion_and_animations.hover_effects: Translate Y (-4px) + Shadow diffusion on product cards.
motion_and_animations.scroll_animations: Staggered entrance for product lists using Framer Motion (initial opacity 0, y 20).
motion_and_animations.microinteractions: Heart icon (wishlist) scale bounce on click. Cart icon slight wiggle on item add.

icons.style: Minimal, clean lines, stroke-width 1.5. Use Phosphor Icons if duotone is needed for marketing.
